title: The opposite of a one shot, I've been painstakingly creating an accurate replica of medieval Florence that can build buildings deterministically so that I can replicate other cities as well
author: VoteGiantMeteor2028
selftext:
I've been working on a campaign map, logistics, and modeling smaller things as well, but this is the progress I've made with creating code for buildings that can populate a city for the time. 

There is no one shot prompt, just me taking another tired drag of a cigarrette before programming again.

comments.author: Pleyar
comments.body: People here only like one shots for some reasons

replies.author: nospoon99
replies.body: For real. Comments are always criticising one shots but they always get more attention. Show some efforts towards gameplay or something more ambitious and... crickets

comments.author: amunozo1
comments.body: This is amazing, I have thought about doing similar things, but never did it. I would be interesting in knowing more about it.

replies.author: VoteGiantMeteor2028
replies.body:
So mostly opus 5.5 high effort. 

I uploaded old maps and concept art as reference images in my repo.

I've been systematically going through things like water level, real 3d terrain, walls, buildable plots.... and then eventually I arrived here but we're not even close to done.

replies.author: amunozo1
replies.body: Thanks for answer! Let's see how much limits I have from my subscription this weekend to test something like that.

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:
Yeah this is the good stuff.

Instead of building the game, build the thing that builds the game.

comments.author: FutureLynx_
comments.body: Bruneleschi himself would be proud of you son
